notes: Mono-Weyland + neutral agenda-and-ice shell, sample Corp deck for the netrunner-sg fixture. 44 rows total (1 identity + 43 deck cards) -- deliberately built to the REAL rule that minimum_deck_size (40 for this identity) excludes the identity, since this platform's deck schema has no dedicated identity slot (see WHAT-BROKE.md). Agenda points: 1x Above the Law (2) + 3x Orbital Superiority (6) + 3x Send a Message (9) + 3x Superconducting Hub (3) = 20 points from 10 agenda cards, clearing the 2-per-5-cards density rule (43 cards -> needs >=18). Splashes 3x Diviner (Jinteki, 2 influence each = 6 of 15 available) for code-gate coverage; every other card is in-faction or neutral (0 influence). Does not include Offworld Office, Luminal Transubstantiation, or Cleaver -- all three are BANNED as of restrictions/standard-2026-08.yaml.
